_about: Recorded Jev request and response shapes, shared by the TypeScript and Python conformance suites. Response shapes were taken from live calls on 2026-09-20; the wording of the questions is synthetic sample data. No live call runs in the default suite: set JEV_LIVE=1 to opt in to the one test that does.

providerRouting._about: The provider routing block the client sends on every call. Recorded live on 2026-09-20: the alpha decisions endpoint returned 200 with this block, and returned 200 again with `zdr: true` added. An unknown field inside the block is also accepted with a 200, so a 200 is not proof the preference was applied.

is_spam.instructions: The message is unsolicited bulk mail.

criteria.personal: From someone the recipient knows personally.

urgency.instructions: How urgent the message is for the recipient.

eachIgnored._about: Trap 5. The caller named three questions and added an `each` key expecting per-row iteration. The key was ignored and ONE answer came back for the whole batch. This looks like a working call. The completeness check is what catches it.

providerRejected._about: The refusal shape, recorded live on 2026-09-20 by sending `provider.only` naming a provider that does not serve the model. HTTP 404. This is what proves the routing preference is read rather than ignored, and it is the case the client raises as `provider-policy-rejected` instead of retrying.

error.message: No allowed providers are available for the selected model. Providers serving typesafe/jev-1.13-20260917: typesafe, but your request's provider.only preference permits only: no-such-provider-xyz.

noulOnly._about: Trap 4. A noul carries a bare probability and NO confidence field. Only choice and score return confidence.
